intro: Wrestling may be the oldest sport people still practice. Painters in Egypt put wrestlers on tomb walls about 4,000 years ago. Greek boys trained for it in sandy yards. Mongolia, Turkey, India and Switzerland each have their own old styles.

Leagues, clocks and weight classes came much later. The modern Olympics added weight classes in 1904. In Illinois, the state high school association named its first wrestling champions in 1937. Girls got their own Illinois state finals in 2022.

In this unit, you will read paintings, stories, programs and laws. You can tell a record from a legend. You can explain why a first championship is a start line for a record, not the birthday of a sport.
bigQuestion: If wrestling is thousands of years old, what really began when leagues and schools wrote it down?

test.q: Where are the Beni Hasan wrestling paintings?
test.why: The Beni Hasan tombs are on the Nile River in Egypt.

test.q: When did wrestling join the ancient Olympic Games, by ancient count?
test.why: Ancient writers said wrestling was added in 708 BCE.

test.q: Which ancient wrestler won at Olympia six times?
test.why: Milo of Croton won six Olympic wrestling titles, one as a boy.

test.q: What festival includes bökh, horse racing and archery?
test.why: Mongolia's Naadam has wrestling, horse racing and archery.

test.q: What do Swiss wrestlers meet on?
test.why: Schwingen takes place in a ring covered with sawdust.

test.q: What happened in Olympic wrestling in 1904?
test.why: In St. Louis in 1904, freestyle joined the Olympics, split into weight classes.

test.q: Who writes the high school wrestling rule book Illinois uses?
test.why: The NFHS writes the rule books state high school associations use.

test.q: What happened in Illinois wrestling in 1937?
choices: The IHSA named its first boys' state champions.
test.why: 1937 is the year of the first IHSA boys' wrestling state champions.

choices: A woman won at Naadam in disguise, so jackets are open.
Robles won the NCAA title in 2011.
test.why: The open jacket story cannot be proven, so it is a legend.

test.q: Who wrestled Abraham Lincoln at New Salem?
test.why: Jack Armstrong, leader of the Clary's Grove boys, wrestled Lincoln in 1831.

test.q: Where did Frank Gotch and George Hackenschmidt meet in 1911?
test.why: Their 1911 rematch was at Comiskey Park, home of the White Sox.

choices: Every school must have a wrestling team.
Schools with federal money cannot shut people out because of sex.
test.why: Title IX bans discrimination based on sex in federally funded education programs.

test.q: When did the IHSA hold its first girls' wrestling state finals?
test.why: The first IHSA girls' state finals came in the 2021–22 season.

test.q: How is a tradition date different from a written record date?
choices: A tradition date is always newer.
A tradition date is passed down; a record is written when it happens.
A record date is always a legend.
test.why: Kırkpınar's 1300s start comes from tradition. The IHSA list is written each year.

test.q: What is the main idea of this unit?
choices: Wrestling is very old; clocks, scales and school records came much later.
Only the Olympics count as wrestling.
test.why: Wrestling is thousands of years old. School records like the 1937 list are much newer.
